stem_book: The ratio of tensions in the string connected to the block of mass m₂ in figure-(a) and figure-(b) respectively is (friction is absent everywhere) [m₁ = 50 kg, m₂ = 80 kg and F = 1000 N; take g = 10 m/s²]. In (a) F pulls m₁ horizontally along the floor and m₁'s string passes round a pulley on the floor, up over a ceiling pulley, down to m₂. In (b) F pulls the free end of a string that passes round the floor pulley up to m₁, and m₁ is tied by a string over the ceiling pulley to m₂. (a) 7:2 (b) 2:7 (c) 3:4 (d) 4:3
